slides.title: What Happened on Nov 2
slides.body: Iran signaled openness to peace talks, and Brent hit a two-week low. No deal is confirmed. The S&P 500 energy sector closed down about 4%.

slides.title: Monday's Market Close
slides.subtitle: Moves on Nov 2 (bar = size of move)
slides.body: 10-year Treasury yield: 4.91%. Tech fell on AI spending worries.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Oil feeds gasoline and inflation. The Fed holds rates at 3.75% to 4.00%. A lasting oil drop could ease price pressure; a failed deal could reverse it.
